# Michael Willi

> Michael Willi is a sophomore at Indiana University Bloomington, Class of 2029, and the founder of Impact Margin. He is part of the IU Innovates Incubator, wrote a venture thesis on lithium from Permian Basin produced water, and is exploring private markets, strategy, and operations. He is based in Bloomington, Indiana during the school year and Austin, Texas in the summer.

## Pages

- [Home](https://michaelwilli.com/): Short introduction and contact links.
- [About Michael Willi](https://michaelwilli.com/about): Full background, Impact Margin, research and writing, education, quick facts, and common questions.

## Key facts

- School: Indiana University Bloomington, B.S. in Merchandising and Product Development (Eskenazi School), Business Minor (Kelley School of Business), Class of 2029.
- Now: IU Innovates Incubator, doing market research and product discovery for new ventures.
- Previously: Founder and CEO of Impact Margin (2026), software that read a business's operating and utility bills and flagged overbilling, cost spikes, and late fees. Legal assistant at Willi Law Firm in Austin, Texas.
- Writing: "Reduce, Reuse, Recycle... Profit?", a venture thesis on lithium from Permian Basin produced water. Second edition July 2026.
- Recognition: 4.0 GPA, Executive Dean's List, Eagle Scout.
- Looking for: Summer 2027 internships in private markets, strategy, and operations.
